story.title: Story 4: Provenance and Canonical Source Visibility

result.planSummary: Implemented Story 4 end-to-end by adding durable source provenance persistence and read APIs, recording informed-work and received-code-update provenance during execution/checkpoint flows, and rendering a process work-surface provenance section with Story 4 API/service/client coverage.

changedFiles.reason: Added provenance recording and read-enrichment service for informed-work and received-code-update relationships.
Added the authenticated process source-provenance GET route.
Wired the new source provenance service into Fastify and the environment service.
Recorded informed-work provenance after execution and received-code-update provenance after successful code checkpoints.
Extended store interfaces and implementations with durable source provenance create/list support.
Added Convex mutation/query functions for persisting and listing source provenance rows.
Added client API loading for process source provenance.
Loaded provenance alongside the process surface and kept the UI resilient if the separate provenance fetch fails.
Added source provenance to default client state.
Extended process-surface state schema with source provenance.
Added the new process work-surface provenance section UI.
Rendered the provenance section on the process work surface.
Added Story 4 API coverage for informing, receiving, and degraded provenance responses.
Added coverage proving read-only attachments are not recorded as write targets.
Added Story 4 client coverage for empty and degraded provenance states.
Updated existing process-surface state fixtures for the new provenance field.
Updated existing process-surface state fixtures for the new provenance field.

findingsFixed: Added bounded provenance persistence/read support across Convex, platform store, Fastify, and process execution orchestration.
Covered the Story 4 read-only exclusion, degraded entry fallback, empty state, and API rendering paths with automated tests.
Adjusted client bootstrap so the new separate provenance fetch does not break existing process-surface route flows when unavailable.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand the story to verification for manual provenance checks on a live process run, especially the informed-work and writable checkpoint paths against a real attached repository.
